name: LUM-201
lead: LUM-201 (ibutamoren, formerly MK-0677 and also written MK-677) is an orally administered growth hormone secretagogue: it binds the ghrelin (GH secretagogue) receptor and prompts the pituitary to release growth hormone in pulses, which in turn raises IGF-1. [2][19] The LUM-201 name is used for the pediatric development program, which tests it as a daily oral alternative to injected growth hormone in children with growth hormone deficiency (PGHD). [2][4]

People interested in height, muscle and body composition follow it because growth hormone and IGF-1 are linked to linear growth, lean mass and fat mass. The chain proponents describe is: more pulsatile GH and IGF-1, then more lean tissue, appetite and sleep depth, then better training capacity and physique, and for young people with open growth plates, possible extra height. Reviews of growth hormone secretagogues report increases in GH and IGF-1 and some body-composition effects, while noting that few long-term controlled studies exist. [20][21] Ibutamoren is discussed on looksmax.org and bodybuilding forums under the MK-677 name. [22][23]

Phase 2 trials in children with idiopathic PGHD have examined growth responses, and researchers have proposed a pretreatment test to identify children with enough residual hypothalamic-pituitary function to respond. [1][6][9] A Phase 3 placebo-controlled trial is registered and recruiting. [4][17] It is not approved by any regulator for any use, and no published study has tested LUM-201 for appearance outcomes in healthy people.

paras: LUM-201 acts at the GH secretagogue (ghrelin-type) receptor to stimulate pulsatile GH release. [2][10] Wikipedia describes ibutamoren as an orally active, non-peptide, selective ghrelin receptor agonist that raises GH, IGF-1 and cortisol, with IGF-1 remaining elevated for up to 24 hours after a single oral dose in humans. [19]

In a comparison of 68 children in a PGHD trial, a single dose elicited greater GH responses than standard diagnostic stimuli such as arginine and glucagon. [2][10] A pediatric capsule formulation was reported to show similar pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic responses to the tablet. [5]

Because the drug stimulates the pituitary rather than supplying GH, the response is subject to the body's feedback, which is the reason secretagogues are described as keeping GH pulsatile and reducing the chance of supra-therapeutic GH levels. [20]

Wikipedia cites a 1995 paper describing the design and activity of the compound, then developed by Merck as MK-0677. [19] Wikipedia describes the compound as in preclinical development for growth hormone deficiency as of June 2017, and associates the LUM-201 trial code with Lumos Pharma. [19]

The pediatric program began with analyses showing that responsiveness depends on residual pituitary function, which led to a pretreatment 'predictive enrichment marker' published in 2021. [1] Phase 2 trials OraGrowtH210 and OraGrowtH212 followed, with long-term safety studies OraGrowtH211 and OraGrowtH213. [11][12][14][18] A Phase 3 trial against placebo in treatment-naive children is registered with a planned long-term safety extension. [4][13][17]

A 2025 review of new directions in pediatric growth hormone treatment includes preliminary data on ibutamoren in children with partial GH deficiency alongside the long-acting injectable GH products approved in Europe and the US. [24]

Phase 2 trials include OraGrowtH210 (n=104, completed), OraGrowtH212 (n=24) and the extension and safety studies OraGrowtH211 and OraGrowtH213. [11][12][14][18] Researchers reported that the growth response in children with moderate GHD depended on the pattern of GH pulsatility induced by LUM-201, and that a predictive enrichment marker could identify responsive children. [1][7][6][3] Interim analyses reported dose responsiveness in acute GH response, IGF-1 and annualized height velocity. [8][9] Wikipedia states that topline Phase 2 data met all primary and secondary endpoints but gives no figures. [19]

A Phase 3 trial against placebo in treatment-naive children is registered and recruiting, with a long-term safety extension planned. [4][17][13] Small Phase 2 studies in fatty liver disease (ibutamoren, n=12) and, planned, with semaglutide in older adults with obesity are also registered. [15][16]

A 2001 randomized multicenter trial gave oral ibutamoren to 18 prepubertal children with idiopathic GH deficiency for 7 to 8 days at two dose levels, evaluating safety, tolerability and GH-IGF responses. [25]

In older adults, a 2008 randomized trial in 563 people with Alzheimer disease, designed because IGF-1 declines with age, reported no clinical effect on disease progression. [26] A 2011 phase IIb trial in 123 elderly hip fracture patients found IGF-1 rose by about 51 ng/ml against placebo and gait speed improved on one measure, while several other functional measures did not; the trial was ended early because of a safety signal of congestive heart failure in a limited number of patients. [27]

Reviews of GH secretagogues report that they can raise GH and IGF-1 and may improve lean mass, appetite, bone turnover and sleep in some populations, while noting that long-term rigorous data are limited. [20][21] Wikipedia summarises studies reporting GH increases of up to 97%, increased lean mass without change in total or visceral fat, and a small study of 14 people reporting more REM and slow-wave sleep. [19]

Ibutamoren is described as an investigational new drug that has not been approved for marketing for human consumption in the United States, though Wikipedia notes some people use it experimentally in bodybuilding and that it is banned in most sports. [19] Products sold online under the name MK-677 are discussed on bodybuilding forums and on looksmax.org. [22][23][28]

A narrative review of peptides in sexual medicine lists ibutamoren among growth hormone secretagogues that reliably raise GH axis markers, and a 2026 sports-medicine review discusses peptide supplements as a category. [29][30]

The pediatric trials are registered with long-term safety extensions. [12][13] In the hip fracture trial the early termination was attributed to heart failure cases, and in the 2001 pediatric study safety and tolerability were primary measures. [27][25] Wikipedia notes the compound raises cortisol along with GH and IGF-1. [19] Reviews state that long-term safety data on GH secretagogues are limited. [20][21]

A looksmax.org thread titled as an 'all you need to know' MK-677 guide describes it as an oral secretagogue that raises GH and IGF-1 and says it is not a SARM; one reply says it 'literally does nothing', and the author responds that the thread is meant to disprove that. [22] Another thread asks where to obtain ibutamoren in the UK, with the poster saying they want to 'heightmaxx' while growth plates are open. [23] A further thread describes a young poster starting ibutamoren together with a SARM and tracking weight gain. [28]

On T Nation, a poster reports taking ibutamoren for two months without noticing a difference after a telehealth clinic prescribed it for low IGF-1, and another thread asks about adding it and a SARM to a testosterone regimen. [31][32] These are individual reports and are not assessed in this article.

lore.intro: On looksmax.org and bodybuilding forums, ibutamoren is discussed as an oral GH booster for height and physique, usually under the name MK-677. [22][23][31]

claims.claim: MK-677 can add height while growth plates are open.
claims.believers: A poster says they want to 'heightmaxx' with it before their growth plates close. [23]
claims.experts: LUM-201 trials measure growth only in children with diagnosed GH deficiency; no study has tested ibutamoren for height in healthy young people. [6][9]

claims.claim: It raises GH and IGF-1 without injections.
claims.believers: A guide thread states it increases GH and IGF-1 and is orally bioavailable. [22]
claims.experts: Trials and reviews report increases in IGF-1 and GH, and a pediatric trial found larger GH responses than standard stimulation tests. [2][20][27]

claims.claim: It builds muscle and reduces fat.
claims.believers: Bodybuilding posters ask about adding it to a hormone regimen to help preserve muscle. [32]
claims.experts: Reviews report increased lean or fat-free mass in some populations; Wikipedia summarises lean mass gains without change in total fat. [19][20][21]

claims.claim: It does not affect testosterone or other hormones.
claims.believers: A guide thread says it does not suppress male sex hormones. [22]
claims.experts: Wikipedia reports that ibutamoren raises cortisol as well as GH and IGF-1. [19]

claims.believers: One reply to the guide thread says it 'literally does nothing', and a T Nation poster reports no difference after two months. [22][31]
claims.experts: Controlled trials show reliable IGF-1 rises, while functional benefits were mixed in older adults and absent for Alzheimer progression. [26][27]

claims.believers: Users cite deeper sleep and appetite as reasons for use. [22]
claims.experts: Wikipedia cites a small study of 14 people reporting increased REM and slow-wave sleep, and a review lists improved sleep among reported effects. [19][20]

claims.claim: It is safe because GH release stays pulsatile.
claims.believers: Proponents point to the feedback-regulated mechanism of secretagogues. [22]
claims.experts: One older-adult trial ended early after a heart failure safety signal, and reviews say long-term safety data are limited. [27][20][21]

card.summary: An oral GH-secretagogue (ibutamoren) in trials for children with GH deficiency; nothing tests it for looks.
card.note: Investigational; evidence is in children with diagnosed GHD only.

quick.overview:
LUM-201 is the development name for ibutamoren (MK-0677), a daily oral drug that stimulates the body's own growth hormone release. It is being tested as an alternative to injections in children with growth hormone deficiency.

Phase 2 trials reported growth responses in some children, and a Phase 3 trial is under way. No study has examined it for appearance in healthy people.
quick.mechanism: It activates the GH secretagogue (ghrelin-type) receptor, prompting pulsatile GH release, which in turn raises IGF-1.
quick.risks: It is investigational and not approved. Safety data come from pediatric trials, with long-term safety extensions registered.

chain: Activates the ghrelin-type receptor to stimulate pulsatile GH release
Lean-tissue and growth effects studied in children with GH deficiency and in older adults
angle.text: Forum users interested in height and muscle discuss ibutamoren as an oral way to raise GH and IGF-1. Trials of LUM-201 itself measure height velocity in children with diagnosed GH deficiency; appearance outcomes in healthy people have not been tested. [22][23][6]
